stories.title: AI superpower ambitions take centre stage as Trump and Xi meet
stories.body: The US and China are vying for AI supremacy while seeking to keep it under human control.

stories.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
stories.body: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

stories.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
stories.body: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

stories.title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
stories.body: The figure was announced during a meeting of the group's board at the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

stories.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
stories.body: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.

stories.title: UK survivor of Canadian poison seller says he exploited her despair
stories.body: Elisabeth Belien tells Kenneth Law's sentencing hearing she took the poison when she was just 23 years old.

stories.title: Dolly Parton's manager accuses her nephew of 'threats and intimidation'
stories.body: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton's death to the world, is accused of trying to extort her estate.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
stories.body: Assault survivor Miriam Haley said the "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".

stories.title: Poland accuses Russian military helicopter of violating its airspace
stories.body: Poland says the aircraft stayed in its skies for 42 seconds, forcing the Nato member to scramble its fighter jets.

stories.title: Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds
stories.body: The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.

stories.title: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
stories.body: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.

stories.title: Federal judge delays ruling on White House media ban
stories.body: During a roughly 45-minute hearing, a lawyer for CNN, Politico and MS NOW disputed Trump administration arguments that the ban was over national security concerns.

stories.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
stories.body: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.

stories.title: Huge data centres rise at 'China speed' to power its AI ambitions
stories.body: The BBC visits Inner Mongolia, an unlikely frontier in Beijing's AI race with Washington.

stories.title: Playing loud music on the bus? That will cost you hundreds of dollars in Singapore
stories.body: Authorities are cracking down on "disruptive behaviours" including eating onboard and putting feet on seats.

stories.title: 'I have never felt heat like that' - a survivor on watching 33 cellmates die in Nigeria
stories.body: The BBC goes inside the prison where prisoners were trapped in stifling, cramped conditions.

stories.title: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
stories.body: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.

stories.title: Neutral venues and no 'away' fans - how Israel v Republic of Ireland became so contentious
stories.body: BBC Sport explores the backdrop to the Republic of Ireland's matches against Israel, amid fraught tensions between the nations.

stories.title: Watch: The arms race in space and how the UK is defending itself
stories.body: The UK has jammed satellites to defend itself from hostile threats, the BBC has been told.

stories.title: Watch: How toxic smog from wildfires is making Indonesians sick
stories.body: Around 175,000 people in Indonesia have suffered from respiratory illness since August.
